confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, extrapolated to July 2026; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Food and drink anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel rates vary widely by area and season (July is rainy-season low season). Cocktail and wine were set at roughly 3x and 3.3x the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. Riel is the official currency, but tourist prices are normally quoted in USD. FX value taken from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as a direct anchor. Regional Southeast Asia basis from general knowledge of Phnom Penh's tourist price level.
